switch.$description: Single size only, same rationale as Checkbox/Radio — a fixed-size control, not a field grid. Native <input type="checkbox"> stays in the DOM (visually hidden, clip-rect technique) so keyboard/forms/screen-readers work for free — only the paired track+thumb are repainted via :checked/:disabled/:focus-visible on the real input, same pattern as Checkbox/Radio. Unlike Checkbox/Radio, the track is always filled (never transparent/outlined) at rest — every reference checked (Radix, MUI, Ant, iOS) draws an off switch as a filled gray pill, not a hollow one, since the track itself is the whole affordance. No indeterminate state — that's a Checkbox-specific tri-state concept with no switch equivalent. Thumb is a flat white circle, no shadow — consistent with the rest of this system having no shadow/elevation token; contrast against the track color alone provides definition, same flat aesthetic as everything else.

trackHeight.$description: 20px — same footprint as Checkbox's box / Radio's circle, so all three line up when used near each other.

thumb.$description: 16px — leaves a 2px inset on every side of the 20px track height.

thumbInset.$description: 2px gap between the thumb and the track's own edge, on all sides.

borderWidth.$description: 2px, only used for the focus ring's own additive outline — the track itself has no border, it's a solid fill.

label.$description: Same 14px normal weight as Checkbox/Radio's label.

default.$description: Off, at rest — the track is a solid surface-6 (outline.strong) fill, chosen so the off switch reads clearly on any surface (page/card/raised) rather than blending into one of them. Thumb is a muted grey (icon.secondary — the thumb reads as an indicator dot on the track fill) sitting on the left.

hover.$description: A 12% lighten layer over the track (off: over surface-6, on: over the active fill) — the sportsbook hover overlay, same as Search/Tabs, applied to whichever base the track currently has.

checked.$description: Track fills fill.active (the brand active colour), and the thumb turns icon.onFill (white — indicator on a solid fill) and slides to the right, popping off the active fill where the muted off thumb would be too quiet.

checkedHover.$description: Same 12% lighten layer as the off hover, here over the active fill — hovers are a consistent lighten overlay across states, not a separate darken token.

disabled.$description: Covers disabled in both off and on positions alike — fill.disabled either way, same pair Button secondary/Input/Checkbox already use for their own disabled states. Thumb stays icon.onFill (white); only the track loses color.

quickBet.$description: A larger switch variant for the betslip's Quick Bet toggle — a 40px track holding a 32px thumb that carries the bolt (quick-bet) icon, rather than a plain circle. Off: surface-2 track, a surface-4 thumb ringed in surface-6, grey bolt. On: the thumb fills warning-yellow and the bolt turns surface-0 (near-black), so the lit state reads as 'turbo/quick mode on'. Shares the base switch's slide mechanics and native-input plumbing.

thumb.$description: 32px — leaves a 4px inset on every side of the 40px track.

thumbInset.$description: 4px gap between the thumb and the track edge, all sides.

state.$description: Off — surface-2 track, surface-4 thumb, surface-6 ring, grey bolt.

checked.$description: On — the thumb (and its ring) go warning-yellow and the bolt turns surface-0 (near-black) for maximum contrast on the yellow.
